card.name: Ending of the word intravenous
card.fires_on: The final piece of the word "intravenous" (OUS or avenous) after it has been split, such as INTRAVEN-OUS or intr-avenous, in dosing and administration text.

modes.label: Capitalized INTRAVENOUS
modes.description: The closing OUS of an all-caps INTRAVENOUS heading.
modes.example: DILUTIONS AND RATES FOR INTRAVEN<<OUS>> INFUSIONS* Procainamide Hydro

modes.label: Lowercase intravenous
modes.description: The piece "avenous" after intr in running dosing text.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the route of administration.
card.plain: It lights up when the word intravenous is being completed, usually just before words like infusion or administration.
